in_sanskrit.name: Rup
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Form, Wealth, Prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rup एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Rup means form, wealth, prosperity. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rupam' which means form, shape, or appearance. In Hinduism, Rup is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who represents wealth, prosperity, and good fortune.
